text:
Morgan - People Ops: quick Q from Ravi: manager wants an out-of-cycle promotion + salary change effective 2026-06-01 but the candidate's start date is 2026-06-10. Can we backdate salary and title? What docs are required? cc @Nora @Eli

Ravi - Eng Manager: manager asks SWE II -> SWE III and higher base as of 6/1 to reflect leveling decision. offer lists start 6/10, candidate accepted. They prefer pay effective 6/1 to match team budget.

Eli - Comp Analyst: salary can be backdated with a signed amendment specifying effective date. We pro-rate by days for retro. Equity should not be backdated if it affects grant eligibility or vesting. We'll prepare a draft backpay calc.

Nora - Payroll: operationally we need: signed amendment, comp-approved backpay amount, payroll reason code, and country tax check if outside US. Cutoff for June manual run is 2026-06-25 23:59 PST. Sample command we use: 

create_manual_adjust --eid 007777 --period 2026-06 --retro_start 2026-06-01 --amount <backpay> --note "OC promo retro"

Sana - HRBP: benefits enrollment starts on hire date (6/10); cannot be retro-enrolled. Title update in HRIS can be set to 6/1 if amendment allows; tell candidate.

Morgan - People Ops: action list: 1) Ravi to upload signed amendment with explicit effective date and tax liability clause. 2) Eli posts backpay calc and flags equity impact. 3) Nora confirms run after docs. 4) Sana confirms benefit note for candidate. 5) People Ops files final packet.

Ravi - Eng Manager: will upload amendment today and ping when candidate signs.

Eli - Comp Analyst: will post draft calc tomorrow. Using daily pro-rate: ((new_annual - old_annual)/365) * days_prior.

people-bot: payroll cutoff reminder: 5 days until 2026-06-25 23:59 PST.

Morgan - People Ops: I'll close when payroll run is authorized. Thanks everyone!"
